query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, c.setName,
       COUNT(ph.id) as transactionCount,
       AVG(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as avgPrice,
       MIN(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as minPrice,
       MAX(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as maxPrice
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk' AND ph.grade = 'PSA10' AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Lillie%Full Force%' OR c.nameJa LIKE '%リーリエの全力%'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, c.setName;
